FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;"><strong>ITEM 4.01. CHANGES IN REGISTRANT&#8217;S CERTIFYING ACCOUNTANT.</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;"><em>Engagement of New Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm</em></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">On December 18, 2025, the Board of Directors of the Company dismissed Bush &amp; Associates CPA LLC as its independent registered accounting firm and on December 18, 2025 (the &#8220;Engagement Date&#8221;) engaged L J Soldinger Associates, LLC (&#8220;Soldinger&#8221;) as its independent registered public accounting firm for the Company&#8217;s fiscal year ending December 31, 2025 to replace Bush &amp; Associates CPA LLC (&#8220;Bush&#8221;). The decision to engage Soldinger<strong> </strong>as the Company&#8217;s independent registered public accounting firm was approved by the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors, following the dismissal of Bush.<strong> </strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">Bush&#8217;s report on the Company&#8217;s financial statements for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2024 did not contain an adverse opinion or a disclaimer of opinion, nor were such financial statements qualified or modified as to uncertainty, audit scope, or accounting principles, except that such report contained an explanatory paragraph regarding the Company&#8217;s ability to continue as a going concern.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">During the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, and through the interim period ended December 18, 2025, there were no &#8220;disagreements&#8221; (as such term is defined in Item 304 of Regulation S-K) with Bush on any matter of accounting principles or practices, financial statement disclosure, or auditing scope or procedure.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">During the fiscal years ended December 31, 2024, and through the interim period ended December 18, 2025, there were no &#8220;reportable events&#8221; (as such term is defined in Item 304 of Regulation S-K).</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">The Company has provided Bush with a copy of this Form 8-K and requested that Bush provide the Company with a letter addressed to the Securities and Exchange Commission stating whether or not it agrees with the above statements related to them made by the Company in this report.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">During the two years ended December 31, 2024, and during the subsequent interim period through December 18, 2025, the Company did not consult with Soldinger about any of the matters set forth in Item 304(a)(2) of Regulation S-K.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">The Company will submit a letter from Bush when available and file on a Form 8-K/A.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><table style="border-spacing:0;font:10pt times new roman;width:100%" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr style="height:15px"><td class="hpbhr">&#160;</td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: black 1px solid;
